request.prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated full-body production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, faithfully reproducing the specific original game model shown in the attached reference images. Realistic game-render finish, crisp silhouette, even neutral illumination, exact material colors and original proportions. Preserve all original side-specific features. One subject and one view only, not a montage or multi-view sheet. Keep the complete silhouette and every extremity inside the canvas with generous transparent margin on all sides. Transparent RGBA background, no environment, floor plane or cast floor shadow, no text or publisher marks. No redesigned details, extra equipment or new body parts. Static image only.

Subject: Grunt wearing his canonical LOYALTY outfit from Mass Effect 2. The FIRST reference is the exact costume color placement and full-body pose authority: charcoal-black armor with orange/ochre panels and trim, small yellow illuminated details. The SECOND is the original artist's model sheet, useful for Grunt's exact anatomy, head, armor construction, feet and the loyalty outfit's rear view on the left. Do NOT copy the white/silver default outfit from the center of the second reference; the output must use the loyalty costume shown in the first. Preserve Grunt's massive Krogan hump and shoulders, compact legs, broad three-toed armored feet, folded muscular bare upper arms, dark ridged brow plates, blue eyes and orange-brown face. Match the chunky curved torso plates, circular abdominal fitting, collar lights, oversized shoulder guards and original wrist and leg armor. Static relaxed front three-quarter pose aimed slightly toward image-left as in the first reference, empty hands at sides, no weapon and no additional helmet. Every toe, finger and the complete hump must remain inside the frame.
